retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key tabletop scene featuring scattered instant film portraits and a smoking cigar, framed by a centered typographic box.
triggerTerms: scattered instant film photos on wood
noir tabletop with cigar and ashtray
boxed serif title over dark background
excludeWhen: modern digital photography style is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, low-key photograph of a polished wooden table surface. Scattered across the table are several white-bordered instant film portraits of individuals with dramatic lighting. To the left, a glass ashtray holds a lit cigar with a thin trail of smoke. The top half of the composition is dominated by deep shadows, featuring a centered, rectangular typographic box with horizontal rule lines extending from its sides.
coreVisualRelationships: Scattered photos create a fan-like movement across the lower third
The cigar and ashtray act as a secondary focal point on the left
The typographic box anchors the top-center negative space
Deep shadows in the upper half contrast with the warm wood tones below
coreInvariants: White-bordered instant film aesthetic for portraits
Low-key, moody lighting with heavy vignetting
Centered rectangular text box with horizontal rules

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portraits are scattered in the foreground; text box is centered in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central instant film portrait and the typographic box above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the text box down to the scattered photos, following the diagonal arrangement from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space in the upper background creates a sense of mystery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks (shadows and wood)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted lavender/grey (text box background) and warm amber (wood highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white borders and dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Wide letter spacing (tracking) for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary title uses extreme tracking to fill the width of the box
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and tracking of the same serif family within a boxed frame.
graphicDevices: Rectangular frame with thin double-line border
Horizontal rule lines extending laterally from the box center

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions
Standard serif that matches the 80s editorial look when tracked out

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of a dark wooden table with scattered white-bordered instant film photos and a glass ashtray with a smoking cigar on the left. The top half should be mostly dark shadows. Apply a vintage, slightly scratched film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a centered rectangular box in the upper third with a muted lavender fill and a thin black border. Add horizontal lines extending from the sides. Typeset the main title in a wide-tracked serif font and the subtitle in a more condensed serif font below it.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting low-key and moody?
Are the photo borders clearly defined as instant film?
Is the text box centered with extending horizontal lines?

adjustableVariables: Color of the text box background
Amount of film grain and scratches
mustRedesign: Specific faces in the photos must be generic or different from the source
The specific brand name 'HEART' must be replaced with generic text
The specific layout of the scratches should be randomized
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cigar smoke looks natural and subtle
Check that the text is perfectly centered within the box
Verify the distressed texture doesn't obscure the main subjects
Confirm the white borders of the photos have a slight vintage yellowing
recipe.reuseFormula: Tabletop Noir + Scattered Instant Film + Boxed Serif Typography
